sources.excerpt: Field Service provides specialized functionality for scheduling and dispatching tasks to field technicians, and monitoring the progress and status of those tasks through to completion. The application has a full range of debrief capabilities to support call closure and reporting time, parts, and expenses associated with the execution of the task. The application also includes street level routing capabilities through Oracle Advanced Scheduler when used in conjunction with spatial data. Oracle Spares Management provides logistics and inventory planning features. A Preventative Maintenance module is included for planned work.
